newsitem.title: USA: Motorola gets $50 mln China cellular deal.
newsitem.headline: Motorola gets $50 mln China cellular deal.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Cellular Infrastructure Group said it was awarded a contract worth more than $50 million to expand the cellular phone system in China's Shandong province.

Under the contract with Shandong Posts and Telecommunications (Shandong PTA), Motorola will upgrade existing cell site equipment and base stations. The company said the additional equipment will increase network capacity to 430,000 subscribers from 300,000 by the end of 1997.
With the expansion, Motorola said the network will be one of the most advanced in China.
Motorola provides wireless communications, semiconductors and advanced electronic systems, components and services.
